name: Switching Between Jason and Lucia
summary: How character switching works, when the story restricts it, and how to bring your partner along.
description: Switching is a story-gated feature. Published launch guidance describes quick switching with the controller D-pad and inviting or splitting up with your partner through the character wheel. Story chapters can temporarily lock you to one protagonist, so do not treat a disabled prompt as a bug. The game’s official character profiles establish Jason and Lucia as the central pair, while the switching guide documents the controls.
requirements: A supported controller or keyboard layout; use the prompts shown in your control settings.
Some story sequences temporarily restrict protagonist switching.

steps.title: Check whether switching is available
steps.content: During some story sequences, only the assigned protagonist can be controlled. In free roam, use the character wheel when the on-screen prompt is available.
steps.tip: If the option is unavailable, finish the current objective or story beat before trying again.

steps.title: Quick-switch between protagonists
steps.content: Hold Right on the D-pad to open the character wheel, then press R1 to switch to the highlighted protagonist (PlayStation control layout). Use the equivalent controls shown in your platform’s control settings.
steps.tip: The on-screen prompt and Settings > Controls take precedence if your button mapping differs.

steps.title: Invite or split up with your partner
steps.content: Hold Right on the D-pad and use Triangle to invite your partner or send them off on their own when the option is available.
steps.tip: Use partner commands only when the story/activity permits them; there is no verified general-purpose tactical order wheel.

commonMistakes: Character switching is story-gated; a lock can be intentional.
Do not assume switching heals, slows time, shares equipment, or makes the inactive character invulnerable.
